subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw route or diagnose Volcano Engine Lite/CodingPlan API keys when a user selects the general `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` row?
rationale: The source mismatch is plausible, but changing model aliases, defaults, or fail-closed diagnostics for a provider entitlement needs maintainer intent and live provider proof.

options.title: Keep CodingPlan explicit
options.body: Require Lite/CodingPlan users to use `volcengine-plan/*` rows and add clearer setup/runtime diagnostics when a CodingPlan-style key is used with general `volcengine/*` rows.

options.title: Add provider aliases
options.body: Map CodingPlan-friendly model names such as `deepseek-v3.2` into `volcengine-plan` if live provider proof shows the entitlement supports that route.

options.title: Leave as documentation
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged and document that UUID-like Lite keys are not valid for the general Volcengine catalog.

recommendation.title: Keep CodingPlan explicit
recommendation.body: Require Lite/CodingPlan users to use `volcengine-plan/*` rows and add clearer setup/runtime diagnostics when a CodingPlan-style key is used with general `volcengine/*` rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision touches provider auth alias behavior and plugin-owned provider routing, where the history points to Peter Steinberger's auth-alias work.
